name: Beverly
source:
Beverly can be as bubbly as champagne and as smooth as a good rum, though spending too much time with her can lead to hangovers... and more than a few visits to Jean Loo. She sometimes has a way of putting blinders on you to forget her troubles and just have fun... but hey, who doesn't! Still, interacting with Beverly should be all about balance - just like the perfect mixed drink.
Likes: Ice, Recipes, Ratios
Dislikes: Sobriety, Online Advertising

[From the in-game Date-a-dex]
